senses.gloss:
नैतन्धव नैतन्धव, अस्, m., N. of a place
on the Sarasvatī.

नैतोश नैतोश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-तोश), Ved.
(perhaps) granting, giving.

नैत्य नैत्य, अस्, आ (?), अम् (fr. नित्य), con-
tinual, perpetual, constant, regularly repeated; (अम्),
n. eternity, perpetuity.

नैत्यक, अस्, ई, अम्, to be done always or regu-
larly and not only on certain occasions, (opposed to
नैमित्तिक); regularly recurring, constantly re-
peated; constant, indispensable, obligatory.

नैत्यिक, अस्, ई, अम्, invariable, constant, per-
petual, indispensable.
